input: Find a pediatrician for the new baby

gold.taskTitle: Find a pediatrician for the new baby
gold.taskDescription: Research and select a pediatrician for a new baby, covering all steps from identifying candidates to booking a first appointment.

questions.title: When is the baby due or already born?
questions.description: Understand the timeline to know how urgently a pediatrician needs to be found.

questions.title: Which city or neighborhood should the practice be in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area so the search can be scoped to convenient locations.

questions.title: Which health insurance plan must the pediatrician accept?
questions.description: Determine insurance constraints to filter only in-network providers.

questions.title: Do you prefer a solo practice or a larger group practice?
questions.description: Clarify the type of practice setting the parent is comfortable with.

questions.title: Are there any specific medical or cultural preferences to consider?
questions.description: Capture any special requirements such as language spoken, cultural background, or specific medical philosophy like support for delayed vaccine schedules.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel for each visit?
questions.description: Establish a maximum acceptable distance or commute time to narrow the candidate list.

questions.title: Have you already received any referrals from friends or your OB?
questions.description: Find out if there are already warm leads to prioritize before doing a broader search.
